attribution.text: OBIS (2026) Ocean Biodiversity Information System. Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission of UNESCO. obis.org.

rights.licence: Per dataset: CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0 or CC-BY-NC-4.0

provenance.notes: Data access page read 2026-11-10: no numeric rate; for the API and the R package "Do not parallelize downloads" (hence concurrency 1); large extracts through the GeoParquet export on AWS Open Data. Data policy (OBIS manual) read 2026-11-10: datasets are licensed CC0, CC BY or CC BY-NC (CC0 preferred); "Any use of OBIS data and/or derived products ... should be properly cited", with the general OBIS citation and each dataset's own citation (dataset, dataset_id); derived OBIS information products are CC0. Commercial use depends on each record's licence (forbidden for CC BY-NC records). No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
